# S. Rajaratnam School of International Studies (RSIS)

> RSIS is a graduate school of strategic studies and security affairs offering research-driven education and policy analysis through specialized centres and programmes.

RSIS, established as the Institute of Defence and Strategic Studies (IDSS) in 1996 and renamed in 2007, is part of Nanyang Technological University and operates multiple research centres focused on international security, terrorism research, non-traditional security, and multilateralism. The school combines academic excellence with practical policy engagement across Asia-Pacific and global security issues.
